commit.message:
Allow legacy regrades with unrecorded artifact exclusions (#3556)

Warn and continue when a legacy directory manifest lacks exclusion metadata.
Keep validating recorded filters and artifact availability, and cover legacy
replay and missing-input behavior with regression tests.

Assisted-by: AI
